hints.content: A dilation by a scale factor of $2$ will map $D'$ to a point $2$ times as far from the origin as point $D$ was, but in the same direction.

Point $D$ is $\purpleC{3}$ units left and $\maroonD{2}$ units down from the origin.

The image $D'$ will be $2(\purpleC{3})=6$ units left and $2(\maroonD{2})=4$ units down from the origin.
